_comment: Retrieval eval set for search_hs_codes(). Every expected_hs_code was verified directly against backend/products.json (grep the hs_code, confirm the commodity text), not guessed. Queries are natural phrasing, not copy-pasted tariff text. One case (mouth freshener) has expected_hs_code: null — it's a deliberate no-match check: this dataset has no mouth-freshener entry, and the function should return nothing rather than force a bad match, matching the real course-content Q&A this feature was built to fix.
